verdict.rationale: Fellow has its own AI assistant (Ask Fellow), so letting users connect external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Fellow acting as an MCP server that outside chatbots like Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the opposite role and earns no credit for plugging MCP servers into Fellow, and nothing shows Fellow consuming external MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
